scope: 446 active graph TP8 groups contain a full external ID transform/Gather/MaskedFill/SUM before a separate padded graph transform/Gather/MaskedFill/SUM, and a third lookup for the later draft. Target and draft tables are untied. In seven active eager groups the target has only one lookup. The extra branch has no four-channel tile before the captured lookup. Eight idle graph groups and one idle eager group retain their separate obligations.

On the pinned multimodal runner the preprocessing path computes embeddings, writes an active prefix to the embedding bank and also passes raw IDs for models requiring them. Dummy capture can choose raw IDs and None for the embedding argument; the model chooses supplied embeddings or computes from IDs. The FULL wrapper subsequently replays the captured graph instead of re-running Python branching. The observed internal lookup is positive evidence of that graph computation. Skip the external branch only for a known raw-ID graph, text-only rows, same ID generation and no other bank reader. Preserve clamping, lookback, multimodal bookkeeping, states and graph key. Mixed image/soft tokens, eager/piecewise, capture, PP ownership or a bank observer need their own path. Storage alias/consumer closure was not directly traced.

Source and native order place the two Engram head-shard lookups on a shared hash generation. Zero removal needs full writes including invalid IDs. AllToAll must preserve peer order, per-layer WKV input and ready events; WKV, rotations, table/weight placement and cache hit behavior are fixed. Credit an eager copy into a final bank only when the next recorded same-stream operation is a full [T,6144] TensorMove and the proposed consumer can read the owner-local bank. Graph DMA and possible extra-reader copies receive zero credit. Single packed exchange across both layers could additionally save at most one launch at equal bandwidth, only if the later lookup is ready before the first consumer. Their benefit overlaps the two separately repriced transfers.

Embedding ID arithmetic/MaskedFill can be inlined in a valid vocab-shard lookup and SP consumers may use ReduceScatter instead of full AllReduce plus local slicing. Preserve padded IDs and SUM numerical behavior, original graph return/alias, full-row readers and fallbacks. Draft conditional price assumes local SP tile/padding can use the same 24-row packet. Native local tile and projection remain. A joint vocab/Engram dispatch would additionally need a common payload/participant contract and unpack or SUM after routing. Different weight tables and hashes forbid ordinary row reuse between them.

Each rotated gate preserves the WKV and FP32 rotation GEMMs, first widening and separately counted immutable preparation. Price six avoidable FP32 full-plane materializations capped at half of measured remaining vector work, leaving reduction, separate rounding, mask and final store. The separate half-vector sensitivity allows half the original vector time to disappear, including fixed per-kernel execution overhead. This includes the old residual-tail estimate once. Active-mask-false may skip K/rotation only with proven mask, preserving zero times V, residual and conversions even for exceptional values. No all-inactive traffic assumed. Padding rows are a subset, not a measurement of actual mask bits.

Every eager group uses original tasks. Graph gate cost uses a separately shape-matched 128-layer sample. Owner/mask fusion prices half the observed owner-arithmetic and mask time. For small payloads use calibrated TP8 ReduceScatter or AllToAll startup/payload, with matched or nearby counts. Large transfers model the removed AllReduce bandwidth phase as half the payload term; Engram routes one eighth of the old per-rank offrank receive. Launch price and bandwidth can change. Wide unknown row readers are outside this estimate.

Aligned timings use the maximum exported end minus maximum exported start. Clock-bounds instead use the causal constraints from 40 synchronized F21 exchanges within each relevant graph wave, assuming constant rank corrections across its prefix/body/draft, or the archived eager offsets, never a single rank correction for the entire campaign. Per-wave DP/stage extrema and original client deadlines permit full propagation. Percentages are estimates. Fully free named work is a sensitivity under the indicated clock model.

The external-only host windows count either the first to last of 14 compute launches, or the wider interval to the next same-stream compute launch after the AllReduce. The wider interval includes host dispatch, communication and possible unrelated work. Neither interval adds to the device estimate. Ordinary estimates interpolate frozen prompt shapes and use the measured verification counts and three M6 graph groups. An additional sensitivity uses the 428 common M24 graph groups, whose frozen row count and batch concurrency differ.
unit: ms for request savings, us for group medians
